fclose.b: That is why Safe House compares multiple insurance companies for your {name} instead of quoting one.

steps: One form. Your vehicle, your address, who drives it. No questions about your social security number, no photos of your license, no payment details.
It goes to every carrier we represent at the same time. They price the same risk differently, and that spread is the whole reason an agency exists.
The prices land in front of you side by side — monthly plans and pay-in-full, whatever each company actually offered.
A licensed Safe House agent goes through the coverage, the discounts and the final price with you before anything is issued. Nothing binds on a screen.

shop.h2: We are an agency, not a carrier.
shop.p: A carrier can only ever show you its own price. We hold appointments with several, so your {name} gets priced by all of them at once and you see the difference.
shop.indieB: Independent means nobody is paying us to steer you.
shop.indieP: We are not owned by an insurance company and we do not have a house brand to protect. If the cheapest sensible option for your {name} is a carrier you have never heard of, that is the one we will show you — and if your current policy is already the better deal, we will tell you that too.

calc.worthHint: Roughly what you could sell it for, not what you paid
calc.premHint: The collision and comprehensive part of your premium — not the whole policy
calc.rowPrem: What you pay for it a year
calc.disc: This is an educational estimate, not advice and not a quote. It compares what physical damage coverage could pay against what it costs you — it does not know your deductible history, your lender’s requirements or whether you could replace the vehicle out of pocket. If your {name} is financed or leased, collision and comprehensive are almost certainly required. Talk to a licensed Safe House agent before changing any coverage.

proof: Texas and New Mexico, with an office on Montana Ave in El Paso — not a call center in another time zone.
You fill it in once. It goes to every company we represent at the same time and the prices come back to you side by side.
Quoting costs nothing and binds nothing. A licensed agent reviews it with you before any policy is issued.

final.p: One form, every carrier we represent, prices back in a few minutes. Nothing binds on a screen — a licensed agent reviews it with you first.

js.fillVerd: Put your vehicle value and what you pay for physical damage coverage above.
js.fillNote: Everything stays in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere and this is not a quote.
js.zeroVerd: Your deductible is as high as the vehicle is worth.
js.zeroNote: Collision and comprehensive can never pay more than the vehicle is worth minus your deductible, so at these numbers the coverage has almost nothing left to pay out. That is usually the point to talk about dropping it — but only if losing the vehicle outright is something you could absorb.
js.highVerd: You are paying a large share of what this coverage could ever pay you.
js.highNote: The most a claim could return is {risk}, and you are paying {prem} a year for it. That is the range where owners often move to liability only — as long as they could replace the vehicle themselves.
js.midVerd: This is the range where the answer depends on you, not on the maths.
js.midNote: A claim could return up to {risk} against {prem} a year. Whether that is worth keeping comes down to one question: could you replace the vehicle out of pocket tomorrow if you had to?
js.lowVerd: The coverage can still pay out far more than it costs you.
js.lowNote: Up to {risk} of protection for {prem} a year. At this ratio most owners keep collision and comprehensive — and if the vehicle is financed or leased, the lender requires them anyway.
